notes: Only a low-resolution booklet was available, so the exact stacking and positions of the plates and bricks are my best reading of the pictures. Piece types and counts follow the parts list exactly (34 pieces).
The tusks are the single white 3839b plate, whose two handles are the left and right tusks.

The body is built as plates, then bricks, and the legs are fitted from below in step 8. The leg tops (3660) and the step 9 stack clutch the underside of the first plate. I recorded these as other_joins because the plate is an earlier piece than its supports.
The 3023 plate b5 is attached underneath b1 (step 3).
3660 is modelled with its catalogue ports only. I treated it as sitting on the 1x2 brick of each leg.
The 2540 handles are clipped into the 4085c clips. The wedge plates are the ears, resting on the 2540 studs. I am unsure of this placement.
Step 9 (3937 base, 3938 hinge top, 1x2 brick) is my reading of the inset: the 3938 is hinged to the 3937 and the 1x2 brick sits on the 3938. I am unsure whether the 3938 belongs here.
